facts.fact: Adwave runs TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram from a $30 daily budget.
facts.quote: With Adwave, TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram run from a $30 daily budget

facts.fact: A $30 daily budget comes to $900 over 30 active days, per the page.
facts.quote: A $30 daily budget comes to $900 over 30 active days.

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing page uses $75 per day as a planning example, which the page says comes to $2,250 over 30 active days.
facts.quote: Adwave’s pricing page uses $75/day as a planning example, which comes to $2,250 over 30 active days.

facts.fact: Reddit is available in Adwave from about $35 per day.
facts.quote: From about $35/day

facts.fact: TikTok in Adwave starts at $91 per day, is opt-in, and requires turning it on and connecting a TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok starts at $91/day and you have to turn it on and connect a TikTok account.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $0.38 per image for extra creative beyond the included campaign creative.
facts.quote: $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $12 per 30-second TV spot for extra creative.
facts.quote: $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave's daily budget has no subscription or contract, and covers media, ads and management.
facts.quote: The daily budget covers media, the ads and management, with no subscription or contract.

facts.fact: ACH deposits to Adwave carry no added fee, while card deposits carry a processing fee shown at checkout.
facts.quote: while ACH deposits have no added fee.

facts.fact: New Adwave accounts start with an empty prepaid wallet, so funds must be added before the first launch.
facts.quote: New accounts start with an empty wallet, so you add funds before your first launch.

facts.fact: Saint Paul Public Schools' teen driver education program serves teens aged 15 to 18 in Minnesota.
facts.quote: serves teens aged 15 to 18

facts.fact: A Minnesota student needs 6 hours of behind-the-wheel instruction under the cited program.
facts.quote: A student needs 6 hours of behind-the-wheel instruction and must hold a permit for at least 6 months before taking the license exam.

facts.fact: In Minnesota, the permit must be held for 6 months before the license exam.
facts.quote: in Minnesota the permit has to be held for 6 months before the exam.

facts.fact: California's driving school advertising regulation requires ads to use the school's full official name and its address or occupational license number.
facts.quote: requires ads to use the school’s full official name and its address or occupational license number.

facts.fact: California's driving school advertising regulation requires the length of each lesson or course to be stated whenever a price is quoted.
facts.quote: must state the length of each lesson or course whenever a price is quoted.

facts.fact: Colorado's commercial driving school rules prohibit use of the Colorado state seal or Department of Revenue seal in ads.
facts.quote: prohibit use of the Colorado state seal or Department of Revenue seal.

facts.fact: Under Louisiana Office of Motor Vehicles rules, a driving school may not advertise in any way until it is properly licensed.
facts.quote: a driving school may not advertise in any way until it is properly licensed.

facts.fact: The page states that a campaign in Adwave pauses on its own if the wallet cannot cover the day.
facts.quote: a campaign pauses on its own if the wallet can’t cover the day.

facts.fact: The page states that Adwave applies a new daily budget the same day if the wallet covers it.
facts.quote: Adwave applies a new daily budget the same day if your wallet covers it

facts.fact: Adwave reads a driving school's website for offers and photos, then drafts image ads, social video and a TV spot, which the school can preview and edit before adding a card.
facts.quote: Adwave reads your website for offers and photos, then drafts image ads, social video and a TV spot.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, some states restrict driving school advertising that sounds like a promised license.
facts.quote: some states restrict anything that sounds like a promised license.

facts.fact: According to the Adwave FAQ, assigning a value to conversions lets a school report revenue and return on spend.
facts.quote: The Adwave FAQ explains that giving conversions a value lets you report revenue and return on spend.

facts.fact: Adwave advises that a driving school use the price of its typical package as the value of an enrollment conversion.
facts.quote: Use the price of your typical package as the value of an enrollment.

facts.fact: Adwave gives examples of conversion actions a driving school can count: a submitted booking form, a call button tap, or a completed package purchase.
facts.quote: such as a submitted booking form, a call button tap or a completed package purchase.
